programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Andreas Ekström: The moral bias behind your search results
programme.desc: Search engines have become our most trusted sources of information and arbiters of truth. But can we ever get an unbiased search result? Swedish author and journalist Andreas Ekström argues that such a thing is a philosophical impossibility. In this thoughtful talk, he calls on us to strengthen the bonds between technology and the humanities, and he reminds us that behind every algorithm is a set of personal beliefs that no code can ever completely eradicate.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: Data collection, psychometric profiling and their impact on politics
programme.desc: Most political campaigns are data-driven nowadays, and many are getting into profiling of individual voters. Recently, a company with a strong background in military PSYOPS has implemented technology developed at Cambridge University, to enable psychological profiling based on digital traces. They have then been embedded into some of the most surprising recent political campaigns: Ted Cruz's, Donald Trump's and Leave.EU (Brexit). I will outline my personal journey, first discovering the technology as a test subject for Cambridge University, then investigating this company as a complete amateur, and eventually contributing to an article shared globally.A background article based on this research was published by NRK Beta early in february 2017, see .The speaker, Paul-Olivier Dehaye, is a mathematician at the University of Zurich working on interoperability tools enabling new forms of collaborative work on mathematical data, knowledge and software. In his spare time, he enjoys litigating (and especially winning!) against multibillion dollar businesses for the defence of his fundamental right to data protection. He is now leveraging that experience as co-founder of PersonalData.IO, a service that helps individuals regain control over their personal data.NUUG talk from 2017-04-04.

programme.title: Open Source in Broadcasting
programme.desc: For a variety of reasons broadcasters are not big users of open source - if anything many still have a viewpoint of Open Source that resembles views of the early 1990s. This presentation aims to explain what broadcasters around the world are doing in this area and what some of the difficulties are in an industry reliant on proprietary hardware and software as well as IPR-heavy. In particular it will look into the creation of the Open Broadcast Encoder (OBE), a professional television encoder running on commodity hardware which many Norwegian organisations have played a role in. Many of the deployments have been firsts for Open Source in broadcasting, not to mention software encoders, silencing many naysayers.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Ernesto Sirolli: Want to help someone? Shut up and listen!
programme.desc: When most well-intentioned aid workers hear of a problem they think they can fix, they go to work. This, Ernesto Sirolli suggests, is naïve. In this funny and impassioned talk, he proposes that the first step is to listen to the people you're trying to help, and tap into their own entrepreneurial spirit. His advice on what works will help any entrepreneur.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: Civic Tech and the Sad Story of Freedom of Information in Hungary
programme.desc: «Átlátszó,» the word means «transparent» in Hungarian, and it is the name of Hungary's first independent investigative journalism website. A watchdog non-government organisation (NGO) which has experimented with introducing Civic Tech solutions in order to facilitate the work of its team, and also to provide citizens with empowering tools. Since Atlatszo.hu was launched in 2011, the Freedom of Information Act has received a lot of attention, and the legal way for questioning public bodies about spending, a «Freedom of Information request» has become the tool for many to reveal information about corruption.Marietta Le will showcase the use of the free software system Alaveteli, and the use of the Freedom of Information Act in Hungary. The law has been changed since 2011, and the latest news is about a threat that would make access to information much harder for Hungarian citizens. Meanwhile, Atlatszo.hu and many others are trying to implement new Civic Tech solutions in Hungary to help people exercise their democratic rights.Marietta Le is an FOI advocate at Atlatszo.hu Hungarian investigative journalism website. She also works with the K-Monitor anti-corruption NGO as a project coordinator to «Be Smart with Data», a program that facilitates NGOs in producing web apps and visualisations using open data. In 2015 the Hungarian Forbes magazine has featured her on their «30 under 30» list for starting «Jarokelo.hu», a street fixing website in Hungary.

programme.title: Nabolaget
programme.desc: Vi møter interiørspesialist og designer Cecilie Nielsen som jobber med både private boliger og næringsbygg. Cecilie bor i en klassisk bygård i Vika fra 1880, og vi skal bli med på en reise gjennom tiden fra interiør som oser nostalgi til moderne compact living.

programme.title: Flipp med Emilie
programme.desc: Det viktigste budet i boligflipping å dele det man kan med andre som også flipper. Vi blir med Emilie ut for å hjelpe til i leiligheten til David.

programme.title: Boligrådet
programme.desc: Flere eldre blir boende i boligene sine – men hvorfor? Vi ser nærmere på flyttetrendene blant seniorer og spør hva som skal til for at flere velger å flytte.

programme.title: Vi på Saltbrygga
programme.desc: I denne episoden blir det musikk, og diskusjonene kommer lett når forskjellige typer bor under samme tak.

programme.title: Bygningsarven
programme.desc: Hvordan ble hus bygget i gamle dager? I denne episoden lærer vi om materialkvaliteter, lafting og hvordan entusiastiske håndverkere arbeider for å holde gammel kunnskap i hevd inn i moderne tid.

programme.title: Wildlife ER
programme.desc: Følg dyrlege Tim når han skynder seg for å redde koalaen Ashley. Møt en flygehund med en ekstra tå som trenger hjelp fra dyrlege Martine. Beregn oddsen for en påkjørt kengurunge med dyrlege Emily, og feir at 50 lorier blir sluppet fri.

programme.title: Mekongs mysterier
programme.desc: Mekongelven er en livskilde for østlige Thailand, fra velholdte rismarker til tropisk regnskog. Se gibbonaper forhandle familiesaker, og se hvordan gruveslanger skaper fare for regionens sarte livsnettverk.

programme.title: Å bli en elefant: De foreldreløse fra Reteti
programme.desc: Besøk elefant-fristedet Reteti, som er drevet av lokalsamfunnet, der surrogatmødre tilbyr overlevelsestrening og omsorg for unge elefanter gjennom lek. Bli kjent med snabelløse Long’uro og se hvorfor 6-åringen Keleles sykdom kan forsinke friheten.

programme.title: Å bli en elefant: De foreldreløse fra Reteti
programme.desc: Det er en balanse mellom tøffe avskjeder og håp for fremtiden når en generasjon reddede elefanter slippes fri. Ønske de nye velkommen til Reteti-familien, inkludert en babyelefant som ble reddet fra et vannhull og en traumatisert sebra kalt Kisima.

programme.title: Korallbyen
programme.desc: Tilpass deg eller dø i korallgatene når høyere temperaturer enn vanlig gjør høstavkjøling (og overlevelse) vanskeligere. Bli med en familie klovnefisk hjem til sjøanemone-utleieren, og se rensefisk gi djevelrokker en skikkelig spa-dag.

programme.title: Afrika
programme.desc: Vi følger en spesiell løveunge som har hatt en tøff oppvekst. Han ble mobbet av storebrødrene og avvist av moren, men den unge løven har nå blitt tenåring.

programme.title: Afrika
programme.desc: Møt den forkjælede, unge hunnleoparden Chipadzua, som aldri har måttet jakte for å få mat, takket være hennes tålmodige mor. Vil hun utvikle egenskapene som trengs for å overleve når hun nå for første gang er alene i livet?

programme.title: Villhunder: Å leve i flokk
programme.desc: Det ser ut til å være uunngåelig at unghunder i Manzi-flokken snart vil splittes fra flokken. Tørketiden tvinger Kakuli-flokken til å ta sjanser. En ny hund har blitt med i Storkekolonien.

programme.title: Afrika
programme.desc: Vi følger en spesiell løveunge som har hatt en tøff oppvekst. Han ble mobbet av storebrødrene og avvist av moren, men den unge løven har nå blitt tenåring.

programme.title: Afrika
programme.desc: Møt den forkjælede, unge hunnleoparden Chipadzua, som aldri har måttet jakte for å få mat, takket være hennes tålmodige mor. Vil hun utvikle egenskapene som trengs for å overleve når hun nå for første gang er alene i livet?

programme.title: Månens ville side
programme.desc: Besøk en verden full av romanse og eventyr under stjernene. Forelsk deg i salviejerpens parringsdans, se et par polarrever gjenforenes, flyt blant ynglende fisk på et korallrev, og besøk parringsdammene til smed-trefroskene i måneskinnet.

programme.title: Arabiske hav
programme.desc: Det er sommer i Omangolfen. Den stekende arabiske solen varmer opp det grunne vannet til 86 grader, noe som gir en oppblomstring av alger på et stort korallrev. Dette tiltrekker seg tusenvis av sultne planteetere, og skaper en områdekrig blant fiskene.

programme.title: Arabiske hav
programme.desc: Havskilpadden er et av de eldste dyrene i verden. Disse eldgamle havdyrene er til og med eldre enn dinosaurene. De har eksistert relativt uforandret i over 100 millioner år, men nå er alle de syv gjenværende artene utrydningstruet.

programme.title: Australias ville fugler
programme.desc: Hør historien om Harry og Sally, et par små pingviner. Disse fuglene som ikke kan fly, står for noen av de mest bråkete nabolagene i naturen. Historien deres er en familiesaga om trofaste parforhold, engasjert husstell og intenst natteliv.

programme.title: Mekongs mysterier
programme.desc: Kambodsja er delt i to av Mekongs kraftfulle vann, og defineres av forholdet sitt til denne store elven. Se hvorfor landet er et biologisk mangfold, og utforsk de gjemte skjulestedene til dyregrupper som overlever i de urørte habitatene.

programme.title: Villhunder: Å leve i flokk
programme.desc: Julz er inne i sin siste uke. Storkekolonien sprer seg etter et møte med en løve. Julz ser at Kakuli-valpene spiser av et pukukadaver, og Manzi-flokken slåss mot et villsvin ved Luangwa.

programme.title: Arabiske hav
programme.desc: Det er sommer i Omangolfen. Den stekende arabiske solen varmer opp det grunne vannet til 86 grader, noe som gir en oppblomstring av alger på et stort korallrev. Dette tiltrekker seg tusenvis av sultne planteetere, og skaper en områdekrig blant fiskene.

programme.title: Beistets overlevelse
programme.desc: Kryss Namibørkenen med den afrikanske savanneelefanten og lær hvordan de holder seg avkjølt i et område med lite mat og skygge. Finn ut hvordan denne kjempen spiser spesifikke planter, graver brønner og går over utallige sanddyner på jakt etter vann.

programme.title: Amerikas ville årstider
programme.desc: Sommeren fører med seg lange, varme dager som dyrelivet elsker. Se når dyrene lærer nye ferdigheter, konkurrerer om maker og unnslipper rovdyr mens de prøver å få mest mulig ut av den korte årstiden.

programme.title: Amerikas ville årstider
programme.desc: Når høsten brer seg over Amerika og trærne skifter farge, må dyrene ta livsviktige avgjørelser. Finn ut hvordan hvithodehavørner, bevere og andre dyr forbereder seg på de kalde, mørke og magre månedene som ligger foran dem.

programme.title: Australias ville fugler
programme.desc: Emuen er Australias største naturlige hjemmehørende fugl, og den nest største fuglen i verden etter slettestrutsen. Den er to meter høy, har et løpssteg på nesten tre meter og kan ikke fly. Den lever i en omvendt verden, der hunnene bestemmer, eggene er grønne og hannene har alt arbeidet med å lage og oppfostre bittesmå fugleunger kjent som "stripeys" på grunn av stripene.

programme.title: Mekongs mysterier
programme.desc: Mekong er livslinjen til Kambodsja, spesielt i den knusktørre tørketiden, der fuktighet er vanskelig å finne. Lær hvordan alle slags flygende skapninger, fra fugler til flaggermus, håndterer ressursene frem til regntiden endelig kommer.

programme.title: Wagner's Jews
programme.desc: Richard Wagner was notoriously anti-Semitic, and his writings on Jews were later embraced by Hitler and the Nazis. But for years, many of Wagner‘s closest associates were Jews - young musicians who became personally devoted to him, and provided crucial help to his work and career. Why were they drawn to him? And how could Wagner even accept their embrace? These questions are at the heart of ‘Wagner‘s Jews’, the first film to focus on Wagner‘s complex personal relationships with Jews. Filmed on location in Germany, Switzerland, and Italy, ‘Wagner‘s Jews’ reveals this remarkable story through archival sources, re-enactments, interviews, and performances of original musical works by Wagner‘s Jewish colleagues. Featuring Zubin Mehta and Leon Botstein among others, the film also explores the ongoing controversy over performing Wagner‘s music in Israel. The same questions asked in Wagner‘s time still resonate today: is it possible to separate the art from its creator? Can sublime music transcend prejudice and bigotry, and the weight of history?Subtitles available for this program with your remote controlSubtítulos disponibles para este programa con su control remoto.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Joyau de géométrie et de rigueur, cette bibliothèque est l'un des derniers chefs-d'œuvre de Louis Kahn. En disposant les lecteurs sur la périphérie du bâtiment, près de la lumière du jour, et en créant un immense hall central, Louis Kahn réinvente le plan de la bibliothèque. Achevée en 1971 dans la petite ville d'Exeter, dans l'État américain du New Hampshire, la bibliothèque de l'Exeter Academy forme un mystérieux monolithe de brique aux 4 façades identiques sur 8 étages.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: François Boucq draws from morning to night in his studio, alone, as if he wanted to be more closely involved with his characters, moving from the savagery of the American West to the diplomacy of the Vatican, from the urban jungle to the news of the daily press. He has been drawing for 40 years with realism, with a precise and detailed line, a graphic finesse that makes him one of the undisputed masters of today's comics.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: The man with the long greying beard who we find in this self-portrait is the painter Camille Pissarro (1830-1903). A keen follower of the Impressionist movement, the artist specialised in landscapes around Paris, often painted in winter, such as the “Chestnut Tress at Louveciennes” or the urban landscapes of Montmartre. Towards the end of his life, his painting technique changed and he turned towards Neo-Impressionism, for example in the “Seine River and Louvre Palace”.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Of Spanish origin, Francis Picabia was an active member of the Dada group. However, being both provocative and iconoclastic, he soon began to scorn the serious nature of the avant-garde movements. His painting was at times realistic, at times abstract, and he sought above all to explore potential in art. This collection opens the doors of the Centre Pompidou (Paris) which presents some of Picabia’s major works, such as his famous “Cacodylic Eye” and “Adoration of the Calf”, recently acquired by the museum. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Architecte et urbaniste, Kenzo Tange est l'un des architectes les plus influents de sa génération; il a initié le Japon à l'architecture moderne, découverte dans le travail des maîtres. Il fut, en 1987, le premier Japonais à recevoir le prix Pritzker, la plus haute distinction mondiale en architecture. Il faut remonter à la défaite du Japon après la deuxième guerre mondiale et aux années qui ont suivi : l'occupation du Japon par les Américains, son absence de la scène internationale, sa lente reconstruction économique pour comprendre la vraie origine des 2 gymnases olympiques construits par Kenzo Tange pour les Jeux Olympiques de 1964. Il est rare qu'un bâtiment incarne autant d'ambitions : celles d'un architecte et d'une équipe de 25 jeunes architectes et urbanistes, celles d'une ville, celles d'un pays décidé à redevenir une puissance mondiale.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Of Spanish origin, Francis Picabia was an active member of the Dada group. However, being both provocative and iconoclastic, he soon began to scorn the serious nature of the avant-garde movements. His painting was at times realistic, at times abstract, and he sought above all to explore potential in art. This collection opens the doors of the Centre Pompidou (Paris) which presents some of Picabia’s major works, such as his famous “Cacodylic Eye” and “Adoration of the Calf”, recently acquired by the museum. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Architecte et urbaniste, Kenzo Tange est l'un des architectes les plus influents de sa génération; il a initié le Japon à l'architecture moderne, découverte dans le travail des maîtres. Il fut, en 1987, le premier Japonais à recevoir le prix Pritzker, la plus haute distinction mondiale en architecture. Il faut remonter à la défaite du Japon après la deuxième guerre mondiale et aux années qui ont suivi : l'occupation du Japon par les Américains, son absence de la scène internationale, sa lente reconstruction économique pour comprendre la vraie origine des 2 gymnases olympiques construits par Kenzo Tange pour les Jeux Olympiques de 1964. Il est rare qu'un bâtiment incarne autant d'ambitions : celles d'un architecte et d'une équipe de 25 jeunes architectes et urbanistes, celles d'une ville, celles d'un pays décidé à redevenir une puissance mondiale.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The spectacular sculptures and paintings of Michelangelo seem so familiar to us, but what do we really know about this renaissance genius? Who was this ambitious and passionate man? A virtuoso craftsman, Michelangelo’s artistry is evident in everything he touched. Beautiful and diverse works such as the towering statue of David, the deeply moving Pietà in the Papal Basilica of St. Peter and his tour-de-force, the Sistine Chapel ceiling still leave us breathless today.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: 200 years after it opened and a century after acquiring its first Van Gogh works, the National Gallery hosted the largest Van Gogh exhibition ever held in the UK (September 14, 2024 to January 19, 2025). The exhibition was a huge success, unanimously praised by the press, and tickets sold out quickly, making this film the only way to see what Forbes called a “once-in-a-lifetime exhibition.”Discover the passion that drove one of the world's most beloved artists to revolutionize art. Van Gogh: Poets & Lovers rewrites history and celebrates Van Gogh's genius without exploiting his suffering, allowing audiences to truly understand this iconic artist in a whole new way...

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Without Camille Pissarro, there is no Impressionist movement. He is rightfully known as the father of Impressionism.It was a dramatic path that Pissarro followed, and throughout it all he wrote extensively to his family. It is through these intimate and revealing letters that this gripping film reveals Pissarro’s life and work.Born in the West Indies, Pissarro found his passion in paint as a young man in Paris, and by the age of 43 had corralled a group of enthusiastic artists into a new collective. Their first show was scorned by the critics, but the group had acquired a new name: the Impressionists. For the next 40 years Pissarro was the driving force behind what has today become the world’s favourite artistic movement.The Ashmolean Museum has a long tradition of excellence. As the UK’s first ever public museum (it opened its doors in May 1683) it houses a wonderfully rich collection, including the remarkable Pissarro archive. With exclusive access to most extensive archive of.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: “Happiness is an angel with a serious face.” These words by the Italian painter Amadeo Modgliani define to perfection the portraits which made him famous… He reinvented the icon, with his oval faces, his elongated necks and lapis-lazuli eyes which are strangely expressive even when robbed of substance. You will be able to appreciate the simplicity of his figures, the restraint in his lines and colours, especially when you admire “The Woman with the Blue Eyes” or the “Portrait of Anna Zborowska”. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, (1525-1569) is one of the most renowned Flemish painters of the Renaissance. Although influenced by Italian art, his paintings maintained a typically Flemish tradition. A “peasant” painter, he depicted the lives of his country’s common folk as in the “Peasant Wedding”. In “Netherlandish Proverbs”, he wittily transcribes dozens of popular sayings. Admire also his incomplete “Tower of Babel”, a theme which Bruegel made into his own speciality.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les chefs télévisés Aldo Zilli et Ching He-Huang s’affrontent lors de ce Road Trip à travers le sud-est de l’Angleterre, accompagnés des experts Natasha Raskin et Paul Laidlaw.Aldo mise sur une bague en or malgré les conseils des experts, tandis que Ching espère que des antiquités d’origine orientale feront un beau score aux enchères dans le nord de Londres.En chemin, Aldo fait une halte pour rencontrer Jill, une doyenne de 200 ans qui fournissait autrefois la population en farine. De son côté, l’amoureuse des animaux Ching découvre l’histoire d’un homme qui, au XIXe siècle, a risqué le ridicule et la ruine pour protéger le bétail.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: Alley of Poplars by Sisley, Nice Museum of Fine Arts
programme.desc: Sisley was a British Impressionist painter, closely associated with Renoir and Monet. On 20 June 1978, at 8.30 pm, a truck was stolen. Inside were around ten masterpieces worth 1.5 billion francs. The transport company responsible for returning the works following a loan had made no security arrangements. On 21 September 1998, ‘The Avenue of Poplars’ was stolen once again. This time, it was the curator of the Musée des Beaux-Arts in Nice, Jean Fornéris, who staged his own abduction! Finally, on Sunday 5 August 2007, five masked and armed men held up staff at the Nice museum to steal four paintings, including the Sisley. It was not until 2008, with the help of the FBI – which was also searching for works stolen from the Boston Museum – that the thieves were arrested.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: On the night of 17–18 October 1984, three criminals broke into the municipal museum in Semur-en-Auxois, which was not fitted with an alarm system. The joint investigation by the French and Japanese police revealed links between the Parisian underworld and the Japanese Yakuza mafia. Indeed, Shinchi Fujikuma, a Japanese gangster, had met two members of the Aubervilliers gang, Philippe-Emile Jamin and Youssef Khimoun, whilst serving time in a French prison. In 1987, the French managed to return from Japan with four of the five stolen paintings. The last one, *The Portrait of Mrs Baudot*, remained with its new owner, in accordance with the principle of ‘good faith’ guaranteed by Japanese law.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: Looting of the Gentili Di Giuseppe Collection
programme.desc: Federico Gentili di Giuseppe was a Jewish businessman of Italian origin with a passion for art. On his death in 1940, he bequeathed a collection of 150 paintings to his two children, Marcel and Adriana, who had become naturalised French citizens. In 1941, Maître Moulin auctioned off these paintings under questionable circumstances. This marked the beginning of a legal battle waged by the Gentili di Giuseppe heirs, which was to last nearly 50 years.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Cette exposition très attendue à la Royal Academy of Arts était la toute première rétrospective consacrée au portrait d'Édouard Manet. Couvrant l'ensemble de la carrière de cet artiste énigmatique et parfois controversé, l'exposition a rassemblé des œuvres provenant d'Europe, d'Asie et des États-Unis. Le portrait de Manet n'a jamais fait l'objet d'une exposition, bien qu'il représente environ la moitié de sa production artistique. Il a peint sa famille, ses amis et les personnalités littéraires, politiques et artistiques de l'époque, donnant vie non seulement à ses sujets mais aussi à la société parisienne.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Qui était Frida Kahlo ? Voyagez dans la vie d'une véritable icône, découvrez son art et la vérité qui se cache derrière sa vie souvent mouvementée. La combinaison d'interviews, de commentaires et d'une exploration détaillée de l'art de Kahlo, offre un trésor de couleurs et un festin de vitalité. Ce documentaire personnel et intime offre un accès privilégié à ses œuvres, et met en lumière sa créativité fébrile, sa résilience et sa soif inégalée pour la vie.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: L'icône de la pop et actrice Claire Grogan retrouve son compatriote de Glasgow, l’acteur Alex Norton de Taggart, pour une quête de trésors antiques lucratifs. Anita Manning et Paul Laidlaw sont là pour leur prodiguer leurs conseils d’experts.Anita et Alex se retrouvent embarqués dans un Boat Trip d'antiquités, évoquant leurs souvenirs d'enfance sur le Clyde. Pendant ce temps, Claire et Paul découvrent de près à quoi ressemblait le château de Stirling au XVIe siècle.Le résultat de la vente aux enchères à Ayr dépendra d’une dame nue.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Comedy legend Jennifer Saunders and best pal, top actress Patricia Potter take to the road on a humdinger of a trip. Joined by veteran antiquers Phillip Serrell and Mark Stacey they shop in Berkshire, Hampshire and Oxfordshire before heading for an auction in Greenwich, London. Jennifer and Phil detour to hear about Fred Karno, the man credited with inventing slapstick comedy. While Patricia and Mark learn how a surgeon from Reading used his incredible sense of smell to successfully treat soldiers injured in World War One.And, Phil gets custard pied – what’s not to love?

programme.title: China - Masters of the Arts
programme.sub-title: Qiu Xiaoqiu and His Shagrila School
programme.desc: A lover of Tibet and high mountains, painter Qiu Xiaoqiu has made more than twenty journeys across the Tibetan highlands. He brought back striking portraits of nomads wandering through the mineral vastness of the Himalayas. The first Chinese artist to paint animals in their natural habitat, one of his works depicting pandas inspired the world-famous WWF logo.

programme.title: Firemen of Paris: saving Notre-Dame!
programme.desc: The fire at Notre-Dame de Paris on April 15, 2019, shocked the world. The flames ravaged the cathedral's roof and threatened to destroy its historic heritage, including its precious stained-glass windows and millennia-old sculptures.The firefighters worked tirelessly to bring the blaze under control, managing to save the main structure and some of the most precious relics.The incident sparked a massive wave of international solidarity, with pledges of funding for the reconstruction of this iconic building, which is a symbol of French culture and history.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Based on a major exhibition at the Ashmolean Museum in Oxford, Tokyo Stories spans 400 years of incredibly rich art, from Hokusai’s prints to Pop Art posters, via contemporary photography, manga, cinema and street art. The exhibition was a huge success and attracted a significantly younger and more diverse audience than usual. The film draws on the exhibition to take us to Tokyo and explore the city’s art and artistic figures in greater depth. A superbly illustrated and richly detailed documentary, which traces the journey of a metropolis marked by ceaseless cycles of destruction and rebirth throughout its 400-year history, to become one of the most dynamic and fascinating cities in the world today.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Antonio Canal, known as Canaletto, and Francesco Guardi are the best known 18th century painters of the urban Venetian landscape. In minute detail, they painted iconic views of the Venetian Republic, destined for rich foreign visitors. “Maria della Salute from the Grand Canal in Venice” by Canaletto and “Venice: Piazza San Marco” by Guardi followed this trend. Later Venice also inspired Paul Signac’s “The Green Veil, Venice”. Go on a voyage of discovery...Enjoy your visit!

programme.desc: Actor and charmer Nigel Havers and his canny, deal-making chum (and ex-agent) Michael Whitehall explore the West Country. Travelling by Bentley and TVR, they’ll have £400 each and expert advice from Margie Cooper and James Braxton. But what will do best at the auction... Nigel’s old cockle bucket or Michael’s tambourine? Plus there’s a trip to see some Bristol Savages and bit of Georgian elegance with the story of ‘The King of Bath’.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Créé à la fin du XIXe siècle par le collectionneur Richard Wallace, ce musée privé de Londres conserve une très belle collection de peintures européennes. On peut entre autres y admirer Le cavalier riant de Frans Hals ou le Portrait de Titus, le fils de Rembrandt. La peinture française du XVIIIe siècle dans sa veine galante et rococo y est particulièrement bien représentée avec, bien sûr, le chef-d’œuvre de la peinture libertine de Fragonard, Les hasards heureux de l’escarpolette.Bonne visite !

A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Au 16ème siècle, le cardinal Scipione Borghèse, neveu du Pape, fait construire une villa pour accueillir spécialement sa collection privée d’œuvres d’art, l’une des plus importantes de l’époque. Achetée par l’Etat italien en 1902, cette collection d’une immense richesse rassemble des chefs d’œuvres inestimables signés par les plus grands artistes. Découvrez ainsi l’une des copies de Léda et le cygne de De Vinci ou le David de Caravage. Bonne visite !

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Créé à la fin du XIXe siècle par le collectionneur Richard Wallace, ce musée privé de Londres conserve une très belle collection de peintures européennes. On peut entre autres y admirer Le cavalier riant de Frans Hals ou le Portrait de Titus, le fils de Rembrandt. La peinture française du XVIIIe siècle dans sa veine galante et rococo y est particulièrement bien représentée avec, bien sûr, le chef-d’œuvre de la peinture libertine de Fragonard, Les hasards heureux de l’escarpolette.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: The Alhambra is a palace, or rather a complex of two palaces built by two successive caliphs in the 14th century, Yusuf I (1333-1353) and Mohammed V (1353-1391). These two palaces are surrounded by an older fortress (10th century), crowning a 700-meter-long rocky outcrop with reddish walls (Al-Hamra means red). The two palaces are contiguous. They form a single complex organized around two patios. The overall plan is asymmetrical, with the two patios set at right angles to each other. Circulation is tortuous. In the 14th century, it's hard to imagine an architect who didn't like regularity and symmetry! Here, all is refinement: the earthenware mosaics on the floors, the sculpted plasterwork on the walls, the carved, sculpted and painted woodwork on the ceilings - everything is a declension of geometric, floral or epigraphic motifs. It's all part of a complex yet harmonious decor. To understand this distribution of spaces, so radically different from the Florentine palace or Renaissa.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Canaletto and the Art of Venice
programme.desc: Canaletto et l’art de Venise, un voyage en immersion dans la vie et l’art du célèbre peintre de Venise. Aucun artiste n’a su mieux capturer l’essence et le charme de cette ville que Giovanni Antonio Canal, plus connu sous le nom de Canaletto. La remarquable collection regroupe plus de 200 tableaux, dessins et eaux-fortes nous permet de partir à la découverte du talent artistique de Canaletto, de ses contemporains et de la ville qu’il a su reproduire avec génie. Le film ouvre également les portes de deux résidences royales officielles, Buckingham Palace et le château de Windsor, pour nous en apprendre plus sur l’artiste et sur Joseph Smith, l’homme qui a fait découvrir Canaletto à la Grande-Bretagne.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The Impressionists are the most popular group in art history - millions flock every year to marvel at their masterpieces. But, to begin with, they were scorned, penniless outsiders. 1874 was the year that changed everything; the first Impressionists, “hungry for independence”, broke the mould by holding their own exhibition outside official channels. Impressionism was born and the art world was changed forever.What led to that first groundbreaking show 150 years ago? Who were the maverick personalities that wielded their brushes in such a radical and provocative way? The spectacular Musée d’Orsay exhibition brings fresh eyes to this extraordinary tale of passion and rebellion. The story is told not by historians and curators but in the words of those who witnessed the dawn of Impressionism: the artists, press and people of Paris, 1874. See the show that changed everything on the big screen.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Léonard à la National Gallery de Londres
programme.desc: Un événement remarquable s'est produit à la National Gallery de Londres lorsque la plus grande collection jamais constituée de peintures de Léonard de Vinci a été réunie dans une exposition unique : Léonard de Vinci : peintre à la cour de Milan. Léonard est reconnu comme étant peut-être le plus grand peintre et sculpteur de tous les temps, mais ses talents ne s'arrêtaient pas là. Ce film raconte sa vie et s'étend sur Léonard le visionnaire, Léonard l'inventeur. Depuis l'endroit où il a vécu ses dernières années au Château du Clos Lucé en France, nous verrons que Léonard de Vinci était peut-être l'incarnation même de l'esprit de la Renaissance.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Leader of the School of Pont-Aven, Paul Gauguin, the most exotic of French artists, paved the way for modern painting. There were two main themes which marked his work: Brittany and Tahiti. A rebel, he rejected copying reality in favour of exploring more delicate painting techniques. You will discover here the most important milestones in his work: from “Four Breton Girls” to “Tahitian Women on the Beach”, by way of the surprising “Self Portrait with Yellow Christ”. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: An emblematic figure in Europe at the turn of the 18th century, this corporal who became Emperor of France unleashed the imagination of artists from whom he commissioned many works. Discover the victorious young “Bonaparte at the Pont d’Arcole” immortalised by the Antoine-Jean Gros in 1796. Observe also the portraits of all the guests present during the “Coronation of Napoleon” and his triumphant gesture as he crowned his wife Josephine in David’s masterpiece displayed in the Louvre Museum. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux légendes de la comédie britannique, Ronni Ancona et Jan Ravens, sont accompagnées des antiquaires Phil Serrell et James Braxton pour ce Road Trip. Partant de la ville de Redcar, dans le North Yorkshire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stockport, dans le Cheshire.Jan se laisse emporter et dépense tout son budget, tandis que Ronni se régale d'une paire de bottes en verre très kitsch.Lors d'un détour, Jan découvre pourquoi les habitants de Hartlepool pensaient qu'un singe était un Français, et Ronni reste bouche bée lorsque Braxton enlève ses vêtements. Sacré moment !

programme.title: Art Poster in Paris Streets
programme.desc: At the end of the 19th century, illustrated posters turned Paris into an open-air museum. From Chéret to Toulouse-Lautrec, artists and audiences met in the streets. This film explores this graphic revolution and its impact on society and modernity.

programme.title: Firemen of Paris: saving Notre-Dame!
programme.desc: The fire at Notre-Dame de Paris on April 15, 2019, shocked the world. The flames ravaged the cathedral's roof and threatened to destroy its historic heritage, including its precious stained-glass windows and millennia-old sculptures.The firefighters worked tirelessly to bring the blaze under control, managing to save the main structure and some of the most precious relics.The incident sparked a massive wave of international solidarity, with pledges of funding for the reconstruction of this iconic building, which is a symbol of French culture and history.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to the discovery of the exhibition "Dancing Raw" at LaM in Villeneuve d'Ascq, the museum of modern, contemporary and raw art. This exhibition presents works made by artists, dancers or not, and questions the themes of gesture and movement. It can be a simple photograph immortalizing a movement, a dance, or even reproductions of merry-go-rounds which will remind you the period of childhood.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: En 2013, la Norvège célébra le 150e anniversaire de la naissance d'Edvard Munch (1863-1944), l'une des figures proéminentes de l'art moderne. Munch 150, coproduite par le Musée national et le Musée Munch, est déjà acclamée comme « l'exposition d'une vie ». L'intérêt général est énorme, comme le témoigne le résultat record de la mise aux enchères publiques de l'un de ses quatre tableaux, Le Cri, soit 120 millions de dollars. Cette présentation vous amènera dans les coulisses de la mise en place de cette exposition, en plus de comprendre une visite guidée de la Norvège qui brossera la biographie de cet homme dont la vie s'est étalée de la moitié du 19ème siècle jusqu'à l'occupation allemande lors de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: « Les Tournesols » sont parmi les tableaux de Van Gogh les plus célèbres. Le musée Van Gogh à Amsterdam a consacré une exposition à ces œuvres et « Exhibition on screen », qui a eu un accès exclusif à l’événement, nous guide à travers l’exposition pour enquêter sur les mystères qui entourent ces tableaux. Le film nous amènera également à Tokyo, Philadelphie, Londres et Munich pour suivre les 5 principales œuvres de l’exposition.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les animatrices vedettes Nicki Chapman et Jules Hudson s'échappent à la campagne pour partir à la chasse aux antiquités avec Natasha Raskin et Phillip Serrell. C'est une bataille filles contre garçons, chaque équipe disposant de 400 £. Le voyage commence à Wormsley, dans le Herefordshire, puis les deux équipes se dirigent vers le pays de Galles et l'Oxfordshire, avant de finir à North Finchley, à Londres, pour une vente aux enchères.En chemin, les filles rencontrent un fabricant de sabots qui sculpte les chaussures à la main. Pendant ce temps, les garçons se rendent au Herefordshire Light Infantry Museum pour en apprendre davantage sur l’implication du régiment à Gallipoli.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les légendes de la scène et de l'écran, Charles Dance et Geraldine James, rejoignent les experts en antiquités Natasha Raskin et Will Axon pour cette excursion dans le Wiltshire.Charles trouve une paire de vases en argent de l'époque édouardienne qu'il espère rentabiliser lors d'une vente aux enchères dans l'Essex. Geraldine, elle, tombe sur un homme dans la rue avec un secrétaire Empire français du XIXe siècle. Il lui en coûte une petite fortune - le pari sera-t-il gagnant ?Charles se retrouve dans le cockpit d'un très vieil hélicoptère tandis que Geraldine apprend comment un petit quartier de Swindon datant de 170 ans a influencé la création du NHS moderne.

programme.title: China - Masters of the Arts
programme.desc: When Chinese painting and its ancestral codes travel the world, Wang Xijing, a master of shan shui landscape painting, becomes an ethnographer, portraying the peoples of Africa, conflicts in Syria, and modern migration routes. Rooted in the highest Chinese pictorial tradition, he captures the types and energies of other peoples using ancestral techniques. Through Wang Xijing’s works, we journey across the globe, guided by the grace of Chinese humanist thought and philosophy.

programme.title: Travelers
programme.desc: Today, Travelers takes you to Basel, Switzerland, a city renowned for its culture and art. We'll start by visiting the old town, one of the most beautiful and best preserved in Europe. We will look for one of the 180 fountains in the city and visit the Tinquely Museum. We will go to the Congress Palace and see the Roche Tower, the largest tower in Switzerland.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: John Singer Sargent: Fashion and Swagger
programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Genre pictural existant depuis l’Antiquité, la nature morte connut un regain d’intérêt à partir du XVIIe siècle dans la peinture européenne. Représentation composée d’éléments inanimés, elle peut se limiter à la table d’un repas, comme dans le frugal Dessert de gaufrettes de Lubin Baugin, ou d’animaux chassés comme dans la Nature morte au faisan de Jean-Baptiste Oudry. Retrouvez également des natures mortes célèbres de Chardin, Cézanne et Van Gogh.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or rediscover the masterpieces by Gustave Moreau (1826-1898) on display at the Musée d'Orsay, the Gustave Moreau Museum in Paris...

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: A cross between Taylorism and Bauhaus, the Van Nelle factory in Rotterdam, built between 1926 and 1931, is a gigantic factory where tobacco, coffee and tea were processed until the 1980s. The image is not that of a simple building, but that of a great machine, a great liner clad in glass and metal. Entirely glazed façades reveal the internal structure of the buildings, allowing workers to work in daylight. All movement is by sight through the glassed-in staircases and walkways - transparency is both a writing effect and a surveillance tool. Built by architects Jan Brickman and Leen Van der Vlugt, under the supervision of Van Nelle boss Kees Van der Leuw, the factory is the most important and accomplished achievement of the modern movement in industrial architecture.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les chefs télévisés Aldo Zilli et Ching He-Huang s’affrontent lors de ce Road Trip à travers le sud-est de l’Angleterre, accompagnés des experts Natasha Raskin et Paul Laidlaw.Aldo mise sur une bague en or malgré les conseils des experts, tandis que Ching espère que des antiquités d’origine orientale feront un beau score aux enchères dans le nord de Londres.En chemin, Aldo fait une halte pour rencontrer Jill, une doyenne de 200 ans qui fournissait autrefois la population en farine. De son côté, l’amoureuse des animaux Ching découvre l’histoire d’un homme qui, au XIXe siècle, a risqué le ridicule et la ruine pour protéger le bétail.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, les plus gourmands ne devraient pas être déçus puisque c’est le chocolat qui est mis à l’honneur. Découvert par les mayas il y 2500 ans et plus largement ensuite par les Aztèques, le chocolat fait partie aujourd’hui des produits préférés des français. Et qu’on ne s’y trompe pas : au même titre que la cuisine a ses grands chef, le chocolat a aussi ses grands chocolatiers. Coté recettes, Julie fera découvrir un gâteau qu’on ne fait qu’à Saint Émilien et qui associe le chocolat au macaron, avant de rejoindre le Pays Basque pour un dessert qui ne manque pas de piment. Nous grimperons ensuite en montagne à la rencontre d’une cuisinière d’origine suisse qui fait des pains au chocolat à sa façon. Enfin, vous verrez que le chocolat nous réserve de nombreuses surprises : il possède de nombreuses vertus et s’utilise aussi pour le bien être.

programme.sub-title: Defending water is defending life - Part 1
programme.desc: Les océans recouvrent plus de 70 % de la surface de la Terre. La mer est le plus vaste environnement naturel de notre planète et demeure quasiment inexploitée. En Bretagne, dans les Sept Îles. Puis dans la baie de Saint-Brieuc, au milieu d’une mer d’algues vertes. En Bretagne, l’agriculture intensive s’est développée depuis une trentaine d’années. En Nouvelle-Calédonie, la barrière de corail est la deuxième plus grande barrière corallienne du monde qui pourrait être menacée par la construction d’une mine de nickel. En Normandie, dans le Jardin botanique de Vauville, un jardin extraordinaire compte des plantes du monde entier. Également dans l’Archipel de Chausey en Normandie avec les plus hautes marées d’Europe. Ou encore le Mont Saint Michel. Victime de l’ensablement et des travaux réalisés par l’homme, le Mont n’était plus une île. En Italie, à Venise, au bord de la noyade, les grands travaux d’aménagement, l’industrialisation et le tourisme ont bouleversé le milieu. En Nouvelle Calé.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Do wild animals still exist ? - Part 2
programme.desc: Yann Arthus-Bertrand surprises us with preserved landscapes. And sometimes even with vast spaces where man's imprint remains invisible. Yann Arthus-Bertrand continues his world tour in favour of the protection of the environment and wildlife. From the tip of the African continent, he decides to take down the fences to let the animals roam freely, then he takes us to Cambodia to see if the tigers will disappear. Then we head to London to follow the chimpanzee or to France to study and save the bees.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: USA : La fin du pétrole - Partie 2
programme.desc: La fin du pétrole, c’est la fabuleuse histoire d’une matière première qui, en à peine un siècle, a révolutionné la vie des hommes. Mais aujourd’hui, les réserves de pétrole s’épuisent. Dans sa course folle à toujours plus de production, l’Homme n’a pas su préserver cette énergie précieuse que la Terre a mis des millions d’années à lui offrir. Pour raconter l’aventure du pétrole, Yann Arthus-Bertrand et son équipe sont partis aux Etats-Unis, pays le plus dépendant à l’or noir. En ce début du XXIe siècle, il est urgent de prendre conscience que les ressources en pétrole sont limitées. C’est aujourd’hui qu’il faut agir et s’organiser, pour préparer la nouvelle ère qui s’annonce. Alors que toutes nos économies sont basées sur le cours du baril, demain, dans 20, 30 ou 100 ans, il faudra vivre sans pétrole. Quelles en seront les conséquences ? Quelles sont les solutions qui s’offrent à nous ? Dans cette seconde partie, Yann Arthus-Bertrand continue d'explorer les réponses à ces questions. D.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: "The end of oil" is the amazing story of a raw material which has revolutionized man's life in just a century. But today, oil reserves are depleting. In his crazy race for always more production, Man didn't manage to preserve this precious energy that took million years for the Earth to give out. To tell the adventure of oil, Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team went to the United States, the country which depends the most on black gold. At the start of the 21st century, it is now urgent to realize that oil resources are limited. It's today that we have to act and get organized, in order to prepare the new era to come. While all our economies are based on the petrol barrel's price, we'll have to learn to do without oil within 20, 30 or 100 years. What will be the consequences? What are the solutions at stake? This new episode of Earth From Above attempts to answer these questions. From China to Benin, including Azerbaijan, Belgium and Canada, Earth From Above takes us on a new trip.

Alors que toutes nos économies sont basées sur le cours du baril, demain, dans 20, 30 ou 100 ans, il faudra vivre sans pétrole. Quelles en seront les conséquences ? Quelles sont les solutions qui s’offrent à nous ? Dans cette seconde partie, Yann Arthus-Bertrand continue d'explorer les réponses à ces questions. D.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: With Bangladesh as a running thread, Yann Arthus-Bertrand meets several people who have changed their lives to dedicate themselves to a major project. In Bangladesh, Yves and Runa Marre have created the Friendship Foundation. Among other things, they’ve created a floating hospital installed on an old barge bought in France. Julie Andersen, an ex-advertising executive from New York has come to South Africa to defend sharks with her Shark Angels Foundation. In North India, Kartik Satyanarayan is helping to stop the dreadful exploitation of the lippus bears (dancing bears). He’s created Wildlife SOS, a preserve to rehabilitate the bears that have been rescued and to give work to the men of the tribe who were traditionally bear tamers and entertainers.

programme.title: My Zen Nutrition
programme.desc: Enjoy delicious and yummy recipes, easy, healthy and fast to prepare with our My Zen Nutrition tutorials!

programme.title: My Zen Nutrition

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pour les paresseux et tous ceux qui n’ont pas le temps, Luana Belmondo propose deux petites recettes simples et efficaces. Découvrez son pain à l'ail et au fromage, et ses spaghettis à l'ail.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo puts the avocado in the spotlight, a fruit native to Mexico with numerous health benefits. She offers us a recipe for gambas with cucumber and avocado purée, as well as an avocado panna cotta with strawberry salad.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: It is in the heart of the Sarthe that Julie begins her new tour. Located in the Pays de la Loire region, the Sarthe department is the gateway to the French Grand Ouest. In the Haut Maine region, Le Mans is a city of art as well as a historic city, which played a decisive role in the development of the automobile. The country of Le Mans is distinguished by the diversity of its heritage, having kept in its stones the imprints of all eras. This region is notably renowned for its poulet de Loué, its capon and many other regional specialities. Let's go for a real Sarthe gourmet journey, with veal rouelles à la mancelle, roast poularde and seasonal fruit tart.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: In Sardinia, Mediterranean food, social bonds, and an active lifestyle explain the exceptional longevity of its people. Health is linked to simplicity, daily joy, and community strength.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.sub-title: Sardinia - Taste of Life Part II
programme.desc: Sardinian culinary traditions rely on local foods, generational practices, and sharing. Dr. Ivo Pirisi shows how these habits promote long, healthy lives through cooperation and quality ingredients.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: In La Paz, over 3,600 meters above sea level, we explore the effects of altitude on the human body. Ancestral remedies like coca leaves help relieve symptoms. This traditional medicine illustrates human resilience and the richness of local knowledge.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie nous donne rendez-vous à Bordeaux après avoir arpenté le pays de Blaye, visité deux fois le bassin et parcouru les terres du Libournais à deux reprises, il fallait bien s’arrêter un jour dans la capitale du Bordelais ! N’y-a-t-il pas meilleure saison que le mois de septembre pour découvrir la perle d’Aquitaine, plus souvent appelée « Cité du vin » ? Julie donne rendez-vous à ces habitants pour découvrir les traditions mais aussi les projets plus récents de cette ville chargée d’Histoire et de gastronomie.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: Andean cultures produce foods adapted to high altitudes, such as royal quinoa. With a Bolivian chef, we prepare dishes that celebrate nutrition, culture, and community. In Bolivia, eating is a celebration of the land and its gifts.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: At Lake Titicaca, we attend a Pachamama ceremony to honor the Earth. This stunning site faces threats from pollution and invasive species. This episode reminds us of our interdependence with nature and the urgent need to protect it.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl

programme.desc: A Filipino couple with a shared love for traveling decide to change their lives and explore a passion for eco-tourism. programme.desc: I planetens ville landskap bruker farlige rovdyr mer enn bare styrke for å holde seg på toppen av næringskjeden. For mange kan det å vite hva som skjuler seg i mørket være forskjellen mellom liv og død. Vi møter skapningene som har utrolige krefter som gir dem overtaket når mørket faller på.

programme.title: Villdyrenes rike
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt forvist til utkanten av Savage Kingdom av Marsh Pride, kjemper de tre løvinnene fra Northern Pride for å gjenoppbygge sin én gang mektige familie. Selv om det er vanskelig, forbereder flokken sin hevn og tar tilbake makten.

programme.title: Villdyrenes rike
programme.desc: I en øde del av Afrika er en familie med villhunder på rømmen. De er på desperat jakt etter et trygt sted til de seks ungene. Men fristedet er fullt av rivaler som står i veien for dem og rovdyr som vil ta ungene. Bare standhaftigheten til lederne, Teemana og Malao, kan redde dem.

programme.title: Villdyrenes rike
programme.desc: Bare de sterkeste kan regjere over kongeriket. Fem helter, alle med hver sin egenskaper, leder rivaliserende familier som kjemper om makten og klorer seg mot toppen. Vinnerne blir belønnet med de beste jaktmarkene i det afrikanske kongeriket, mens taperne lider en brutal skjebne - eksil eller døden.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Når det gjelder overlevelse, bruker dyr i alle størrelser hemmelige våpen med dødelig presisjon. Fra bombarderbillenes kokende spray til sjøknelernes eksplosive klubbe og flygeagamernes skjulte vinger, ser vi nærmere på naturens mest fantastiske hemmelige våpen.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Om våren våkner Karpatenes sjeldneste skapninger til live etter den lange vinteren. Det begynner med et helt spesielt øyeblikk når en binne kommer ut av hiet. De tre små, nysgjerrige ungene hennes opplever verden for aller første gang og følger henne over bratte klipper på jakt etter mat. Samtidig, i Tatrafjellene i Slovakia, finner det spektakulære tiurspillet sted. I Ukraina jakter slagugler for å skaffe mat til ungene sine, mens gemsenes nyfødte geitekillinger hopper ned bratte snøskråninger for å unnslippe ørnene som svever over dem. Nøkkelen til alt dette er urskogen. Den gir ikke bare dyrene ly og beskyttelse, men danner grunnlaget for liv her. Gjennom fotosyntesen, naturens egen superkraft, omdanner de sollys til energi som føres videre opp gjennom næringskjeden og holder dette enorme, sammenvevde økosystemet i live.

programme.title: Gredos - King of the Mountains
programme.desc: Gjennom årstidens skiftende sykluser åpenbarer Spanias nasjonalpark Sierra de Gredos seg som et av Europas mest bemerkelsesverdige naturlandskap. Fra eldgamle isbreer og dype fjellkløfter til toppen av Pico Almanzor, det høyeste fjellet i sentrale Spania, kan du bli kjent med et unikt og sårbart økosystem. Her hersker den iberiske steinbukken, en ikonisk art som er innbegrepet av disse fjellene. Ved siden av den lever kongeørner, fjellfugler og otere i et område preget av isolasjon og motstandskraft. Dette er et portrett av villmark og balanse, et vindu inn i et av Europas siste store villmarksområder.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals: Høydepunkter
programme.desc: Ugler kan "se" ved hjelp av ørene, og kan kanskje også høre om mus er gravide. Neshorn har hud som svetter blod.

programme.desc: Frosker bærer muligens på hemmeligheten som kan gjøre mennesker udødelige, mens katters maling kanskje kan holde astronauter i live i rommet.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Etter en desperat leting gjenforenes Kio og Summer med brødrene, men livet i utkanten av flokkens territorium er nådeløst. Summer sliter med å jakte for de uerfarne sønnene og forberede dem på et liv alene, og kampen for å overleve tærer på. Når et lett bytte blir for fristende, får det konsekvenser som forandrer Kios liv for alltid. Han tvinges til å bli selvstendig lenge før tiden, og nå må Kio og brødrene hans lære å overleve på egen hånd.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Kio og brødrene hans har kommet til en ny og farlig verden. Som den yngste er Kio den mest sårbare. Da de oppdager et frodig våtmarksområde med rikelig med byttedyr og en løvinneflokk, virker det som det perfekte nye hjemmet. Men dette paradiset har allerede sine konger. Et brutalt angrep splitter brødreflokken og tvinger Kio på flukt. Alene og forlatt er sjansene hans for å overleve små, men han finner mot til å rope og gjenforenes med brødrene. Sammen møter de en rekke prøvelser, fra bøffeljakt til kamper med rivaler, og knytter et ubrytelig bånd. Til slutt, som en selvsikker og nesten fullvoksen hannløve, vender Kio tilbake for å utfordre de gamle kongene. Seier sikrer ham et kongerike, en flokk og en ny familie. Nederlag betyr eksil. Vil Kio falle, eller vil han reise seg og endelig innta tronen?

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Om våren våkner Karpatenes sjeldneste skapninger til live etter den lange vinteren. Det begynner med et helt spesielt øyeblikk når en binne kommer ut av hiet. programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Sommeren byr på overflod, men i kappløpet om å utnytte den korte varme årstiden følger også konkurranse, aggresjon og fare. Høyt oppe på fjellengene kjemper alpemurmeldyrene om de beste hiene der de kan oppfostre ungene sine. Men klarer de å unnslippe sultne bjørner? Bjørnungene i Karpatene vokser raskt, men trues av voksne hannbjørner som vil kvitte seg med rivalenes avkom. Klarer binnene å beskytte dem med sine smarte strategier? Flokker av europeisk bison dundrer gjennom de gamle skogene på jakt etter mat og vann. De er et av de fremste eksemplene på vellykket reintroduksjon, fordi tråkkene deres skaper liv i hele skogen og gir gode vilkår for milliarder av insekter. Insektene søker videre til kronhjortflokkene etter næring. Plaget av stikkende insekter trekker hjortene opp i fjellene for å slippe dem, men der risikerer de i stedet å bli bytte for sjeldne villkatter.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Høsten forvandler Karpatenes fjellsider til et bølgende teppe av bronse, ravgult og gull. Skogene fylles av kronhjortenes mektige brøl, som varsler kampen om retten til å samle en flokk med hinder. Oppgjørene er brutale, og de svekkede taperne blir et lett bytte for ulveflokker på jakt etter et enkelt måltid. For bjørnene gjelder det å fråtse i bær og nøtter for å legge på seg før vinterdvalen. Til tross for sin enorme størrelse klatrer de opp bøke- og furustammer for å nå de saftigste nøttene i trekronene. De går også inn på menneskenes åkere for å forsyne seg av mais. De gjør nesten hva som helst for å stille sulten. Alle disse storslåtte dyrenes overlevelse avhenger av de gamle skogene. De gamle trærne binder skadelig karbon fra atmosfæren og bidrar til å regulere jordas klima, en livsviktig funksjon for alt liv.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Alpebukker springer ned fra de bratte klippene, himmelen fylles av millioner av fugler under det imponerende trekket, og midt på vinteren leter den sjeldne gaupa etter en make.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Dr. Pol drar for å behandle Louella, en stor purke som er for syk til å amme de 15 grisungene sine. Dr. Lisa evaluerer en nyfødt foles ustødige gange og syr beinet til ei hoppe. Deretter undersøker dr. Brenda en vallak som viser tegn på en nevrologisk sykdom. Dyrlegene behandler også pyreneervalper, søte kattunger, og en schæfer og en 75-kilos rottweiler med beinskader.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Veterinærene svarer på flere nødanrop. Alt fra en hest som ble alvorlig traumatisert i en ulykke, til en søt liten hund som fikk en svært alvorlig øyeskade etter en slåsskamp. Dr. Pol behandler en veddeløpshest med en karrieretruende hovskade, mens dr. Nicole og Brenda tar med seg klinikken på veien. En hissig reinsbukk har en alvrolig flenge i geviret sitt, og til og med en perlehøne trenger dr. Pols hjelp.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Om våren våkner Karpatenes sjeldneste skapninger til live etter den lange vinteren. Det begynner med et helt spesielt øyeblikk når en binne kommer ut av hiet. De tre små, nysgjerrige ungene hennes opplever verden for aller første gang og følger henne over bratte klipper på jakt etter mat. Samtidig, i Tatrafjellene i Slovakia, finner det spektakulære tiurspillet sted. I Ukraina jakter slagugler for å skaffe mat til ungene sine, mens gemsenes nyfødte geitekillinger hopper ned bratte snøskråninger for å unnslippe ørnene som svever over dem. Nøkkelen til alt dette er urskogen. Den gir ikke bare dyrene ly og beskyttelse, men danner grunnlaget for liv her. Gjennom fotosyntesen, naturens egen superkraft, omdanner de sollys til energi som føres videre opp gjennom næringskjeden og holder dette enorme, sammenvevde økosystemet i live.

programme.title: Lion
programme.sub-title: Chapter Two: A Band Of Brothers
programme.desc: Kio overlever mirakuløst et bøffelangrep, men utfordringene har så vidt begynt. Han er bare tolv uker gammel – den yngste og mest sårbare i flokken. Skal han en dag bli konge, må han vinne brødrenes respekt og finne sin plass. Akkurat da han endelig blir akseptert, slår tørken til, og det blir kamp om maten. Summer må derfor ta et drastisk valg for å sikre Kios fremtid.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Etter en desperat leting gjenforenes Kio og Summer med brødrene, men livet i utkanten av flokkens territorium er nådeløst. Summer sliter med å jakte for de uerfarne sønnene og forberede dem på et liv alene, og kampen for å overleve tærer på. Når et lett bytte blir for fristende, får det konsekvenser som forandrer Kios liv for alltid. Han tvinges til å bli selvstendig lenge før tiden, og nå må Kio og brødrene hans lære å overleve på egen hånd.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Kio og brødrene hans har kommet til en ny og farlig verden. Som den yngste er Kio den mest sårbare. Da de oppdager et frodig våtmarksområde med rikelig med byttedyr og en løvinneflokk, virker det som det perfekte nye hjemmet. Men dette paradiset har allerede sine konger. Et brutalt angrep splitter brødreflokken og tvinger Kio på flukt. Alene og forlatt er sjansene hans for å overleve små, men han finner mot til å rope og gjenforenes med brødrene. Sammen møter de en rekke prøvelser, fra bøffeljakt til kamper med rivaler, og knytter et ubrytelig bånd. Til slutt, som en selvsikker og nesten fullvoksen hannløve, vender Kio tilbake for å utfordre de gamle kongene. Seier sikrer ham et kongerike, en flokk og en ny familie. Nederlag betyr eksil. Vil Kio falle, eller vil han reise seg og endelig innta tronen?

programme.title: Gredos - King of the Mountains
programme.desc: Gjennom årstidens skiftende sykluser åpenbarer Spanias nasjonalpark Sierra de Gredos seg som et av Europas mest bemerkelsesverdige naturlandskap. Fra eldgamle isbreer og dype fjellkløfter til toppen av Pico Almanzor, det høyeste fjellet i sentrale Spania, kan du bli kjent med et unikt og sårbart økosystem. Her hersker den iberiske steinbukken, en ikonisk art som er innbegrepet av disse fjellene. Ved siden av den lever kongeørner, fjellfugler og otere i et område preget av isolasjon og motstandskraft. Dette er et portrett av villmark og balanse, et vindu inn i et av Europas siste store villmarksområder.

programme.title: Amerikas ville steder
programme.desc: National Geographic blir med på en spennende reise over 445 kilometer for å utforske Grand Canyon og dens mysterier.

programme.title: Amerikas ville steder
programme.desc: Naturreservatet Papahanaumokuakea strekker seg over de nordvestre øyene til Hawaii.

programme.title: Jaguar: Jungle Icon of Guyana
programme.desc: En ung jaguar skal til å dra ut på sitt aller viktigste oppdrag i livet: å finne sitt eget kongerike. Reisen tar ham gjennom varierte habitater, som alle har sitt eget utvalg av dyr. programme.title: Kannibalhai

programme.title: Perfect Predator
programme.desc: Haiene har utviklet seg til å bli det perfekte rovdyr, med sin store størrelse og finjusterte jaktferdigheter. Vi følger et team av forskere når de prøver å avdekke mysteriene bak disse ikoniske dyrene, inkludert hvordan deres underlige oppførsel – som kannibalisme – er designet for å holde disse tøffe rovdyrene på toppen av næringskjeden.

programme.title: Afrikas elvegiganter
programme.desc: Afrikas kraftfulle elver huser et variert utvalg av beboere slik som elefanter og flodhester som spiser og drikker der krokodillene jakter og formerer seg. Vi avslører hvordan disse gigantiske dyrene ufrivillig deler vannet med andre, mindre skapninger slik som pinnsvin, kampørner og leoparder.

programme.title: Nature's Nurseries - The Next Wild Generation
programme.desc: Over hele verden står alle arter overfor den samme utfordringen: å gi neste generasjon en best mulig start.

programme.title: Big Little Giants
programme.desc: Med Botswanas vidstrakte og uberørte villmark som kulisse følger "Big Little Giants" Afrikas yngste dyr mens de tar sine første skritt inn i en utfordrende verden preget av tørke, rovdyr og eldgamle migrasjonsruter. Fra en nyfødt elefant som lærer å holde tritt med flokken, til sjakalunger som setter instinktene på prøve og gepardunger som forbereder seg på livet i forbløffende fart, hver historie utspiller seg gjennom intime øyeblikk preget av læring og tap. Godt hjulpet av foreldre, søsken og instinkt må de unge dyrene raskt tilpasse seg, ellers havner de på etterskudd. Gjennom fantastiske landskap og nærbilder ser du hvordan mot, familiebånd og motstandskraft er avgjørende for å overleve i den mest sårbare fasen av livet i naturen.

programme.title: Dragens dag
programme.desc: For den største hann-komodovaranen på Rinca-øya setter stadig økende temperaturer og mindre jaktområder han i fare for å dø for hver time. På en utrolig reise får vi oppleve hverdagslivet til dette eldgamle rovdyret, og får se hvordan han tilpasser seg moderne endringer.

programme.title: Amur-tigeren
programme.desc: "Secret Kingdom of the Amur Tiger" tar oss med inn i et øde kongerike for å avsløre hemmelighetene til noen mektige tigre. Man bruker viltkameraer, zoomobjektiver og droner for å følge dyrene tett. Vi får se hvordan tigrene tar seg gjennom og lever side om side i smale passasjer, bruker hemmelige meldinger for å kommunisere med hverandre, jakter på bytter og utnytter årstidene. Det endelige målet er å finne en partner og føre arten videre.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Ekspertveterinærene til PVS behandler en rekke tilfeller, fra en iguana uten matlyst, til en schæferhunds dinglende ben. Med sine trente hender behandler dr. Lisa en kvelende hest og deretter en purke som føder. Dr. Nicole undersøkelser hjelper en shih tzus mystiske sår og en oppblåst geit. Dr. Brenda tar seg av en katt, mens dr. Pol foretar graviditetskontroller for kameler.

programme.title: Hunters of the Reef
programme.desc: Fra menneskets synspunkt er verdens tropiske korallrev undervannsparadiser, men for de svømmende beboerne er det et spis eller bli spist-miljø styrt av store rovdyr. Men mindre jegere beviser at størrelse ikke er alt, slik som dragefisken med giftige pigger, sjøkneleren med kjapp reaksjonsevne og sepiablekkspruter med sin foranderlige hud og tentakkelharpuner. Deres utrolige talenter gjør dem til konkurransedyktige jegere.

programme.title: Asia's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Over hele Asia blir unge dyr kastet ut i ville kamper, og kjemper med nebb og klør for å i det hele tatt overleve. Hver eneste dag byr på nye utfordringer og farer.
